title: Shipment Exception Tracking Log
subtitle: Shipment Exception: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Shipment Exception Tracking Log covers shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action. The shipment exception coordinator records Shipment Exception events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Shipment Exception Tracking Log keeps Shipment Exception exceptions visible until the shipment exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Shipment Exception Tracking Log at origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location. Document shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action identity before Shipment Exception begins. Compare shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action findings with stated Shipment Exception criteria; route unresolved Shipment Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Shipment Exception Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Shipment Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Shipment Exception conditions beyond the shipment exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Shipment Exception, identify responsible parties, origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location, and the linked shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action source.

fields.label: Shipment, order, tracking, and service level
Affected item, piece, lot, serial, and quantity

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Shipment Exception facts for shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Shipment Exception tracked controls
items: Containment, reroute, recovery, or return action
Notice, owner, target, and final service outcome

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: For Shipment Exception, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Shipment Exception Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Condition or quantity cannot be established
blocks.guidance: Pause Shipment Exception when location, custody, condition, customer communication, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Shipment Exception proof and route unresolved shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action scope to shipment exception coordinator.
